question_en: (GlobeSailor) A broker sent a transfer of the net balance (client paid the deposit; commission 15%) and later noticed it was sent incorrectly. Can we refund it or deduct it from the next payment?
answer_exact: For this booking I also received a payment of 625.25 euros on 12th of June; the 120.92 mentioned earlier in our conversation has not come through yet. Of course once it does I will send you the confirmation. For this booking, might I suggest you collect the whole payment from the guest and then transfer the net amount to us? This will avoid the back and forth between bank accounts unnecessarily.

question_en: Please confirm that the booking documents and the signed charter contract were received.
answer_exact: Thank you Mr Dieter, We will get back to you in case we need any further information from your side. At your disposal

question_en: Broker's client asks if a BBQ on board is possible for an extra fee (Astrea 42 Inoe, 26.09-03.10.2026); broker later says gas BBQ is not a safety problem and the client is a fisherman.
answer_exact: Kindly note that we cannot provide a bbq on board for safety reasons. [Later:] Regarding the BBQ, we do not provide it as an extra if the yacht is not equipped with one by the manufacturer, mainly for safety reasons.
